Black & White series · DEX

Dark Explorers

Released May 9, 2012 · 111 cards

Expanded

Dark Explorers is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Black & White series, released in English on May 9, 2012. Its main set has 108 cards, plus 3 secret rares numbered beyond the set (111 in total). It includes 98 Pokémon, 13 Trainer and 0 Energy cards, and is legal in the Expanded format (rotated out of Standard).

Illustrators

30 illustrators worked on Dark Explorers. Most cards: 5ban Graphics (15), Kouki Saitou (10), Masakazu Fukuda (8), Ryo Ueda (7), Akira Komayama (6), Kagemaru Himeno (6), Naoki Saito (6), Shizurow (6).
